name: Hircine's Haunt
summary: Hircine's Haunt is a cave in central Craglorn, north of Belkarth, containing Greycloak Mercenaries and wildlife. The bandits inside are at various stages of lycanthropy, and are also accompanied by wolves as a result. The spacious cave is also home to some ferocious crocodiles. Centipedes are found in numbers within. Bosses have a chance to drop the Chain of the Werewolf antiquity lead for the Shapeshifter's Chain
notes: A skyshard can be found on a ledge near the end of the delve.
The original experience gain from this delve initially made it a popular grinding location before it was decreased.
